INSERT INTO t_production_task (task_no, plan_id, task_type, product_id, product_name, quantity, assigned_user_id, assigned_user_name, task_status, start_time, end_time, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskNo}, #{planId}, #{taskType}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{assignedUserId}, #{assignedUserName}, #{taskStatus}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_production_task SET task_no = #{taskNo}, plan_id = #{planId}, task_type = #{taskType}, product_id = #{productId}, product_name = #{productName}, quantity = #{quantity}, assigned_user_id = #{assignedUserId}, assigned_user_name = #{assignedUserName}, task_status = #{taskStatus}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE t_production_task SET assigned_user_id = #{userId}, assigned_user_name = #{userName}, task_status = 1, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND task_status = 0 AND (assigned_user_id IS NULL OR assigned_user_id = 0)
